scenario: [LNLS.3.10]: a `String` slot operand of string ordering needs `capacity`, so a single-pattern `<` on a String slot with none is a compile error in a `linear_scan: false` file. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_compare` (ordering operator) through `unbounded_string`. `==` on the same slot would be O(1) on interned strings and is not refused, so the operator is what the check keys on.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Line scope logical:
    k: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Line l where l.text < "m"
->
    log info "x"
